scope: Linux x86-64 host with Xvfb 1280x720x24. Production native/guest-bridges/x11_frame.c and patches/guest-bridges/0001-x11-frame-fewer-copies.patch built with the host libX11 and libXfixes. Neither PRoot, Wine, the graphical client, Android nor Thor ran. The patch is not applied to the shipped helper.
method: A test painter filled the root window with a deterministic pattern and called XSync before each request. Each helper ran at its 60 FPS setting behind a private Unix socket. Wire headers excluding the capture-time field, and SHA-256 of each payload, were compared. CPU is the helper's user plus system clock ticks (100 per second) for 240 requests, averaged over two runs per variant.

thorBaselineV25.source: Owner support bundle, v25, 170 s at the 30 FPS cap
